pattern: List of Progress Bars (ARIA progressbar) with native action buttons and a polite live region for outcomes.

roles.role: progressbar (Progress Bar), named by the file name
img with alt="" (decorative; the name is adjacent)

aria.value: Size and status text, including the error

keyboard.action: Moves through the visible action buttons of each row.
Cancels, retries, or removes. When the focused action disappears, focus moves to the first action of the same row; after removal, to the next row, else the list.

focus: Actions show a :focus-visible outline. Focus is never moved by progress or status changes, only after the user's own action removed the focused control.
notes: Announcements (polite): each failure and cancellation, removals, and one summary when the batch completes. Progress is never announced continuously.
Status is text in each row's description, and done/failed add Progress Bar tone icons with labels: never color alone.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
